Client SDK feature matrix

Step 4 of the post-MVP plan, 2026-11-10. Every feature of the catalog, what Sentry, Datadog and PostHog ship on web, iOS, Android and React Native, and the target we recommend. Targets are proposals for the founder. Evidence and sources are in the vendor files; gaps in the spec are in gaps-for-step-7.md.

Headline

  1. Must is the full story on OTel: sessions, errors and crashes, vitals and app start, HTTP spans with W3C traceparent, clicks and frustration, navigation, web and mobile replay with an on-error buffer, consent and masking, offline delivery, symbolication. The draft spec already covers most of it.
  2. None of the three vendors sends RUM as OTLP. PostHog sends only its logs as OTLP. For backend joins, Datadog sends W3C traceparent plus its own headers to an allowlist, Sentry sends its own headers with traceparent opt-in, and PostHog sends only its own session headers.
  3. Should fills the gaps vendors have taught users to expect: time to full display, OOM and exit reasons, console logs, feature-flag evaluations, a feedback API, remote kill switch, WebView bridging, bot filtering.
  4. Never is product analytics: autocapture, identify and alias, experiments, surveys, a flag service, client metrics, separate trace or error sampling.
  5. The mobile replay format is not decided here. The evidence is in mobile-replay-format-evidence.md: Sentry is video, Datadog is wireframe, PostHog ships both.

How this was made

Seven research passes on 2026-11-10 read each vendor's current docs and the source of its SDKs at the latest release tag, and recorded the default from code where docs and code disagreed. Versions: Sentry JavaScript 11.11.0, Cocoa 9.33.0, Java 8.63.0, React Native 8.34.0; Datadog Browser 7.17.0, iOS 3.21.0, Android 3.16.0, React Native 3.11.0; PostHog JS 1.447.6, iOS 3.94.3, Android 3.76.1, React Native 4.85.4. Docs pages carry no update date, so they are cited as accessed on 2026-11-10. This page is generated from the Markdown entries by project/agents/sdk-features/scripts/build_matrix.py.
